entries.title: A card you answered no longer comes back as a new question
entries.body: When your first mate or a crewmate writes again on a card you already answered, it now acts on your answer instead of asking you the same question. It can still tell you what happened next on that card as a note, and a new question arrives as a card of its own. A card you closed without choosing can still come back.
entries.noPicture: This stops a card from coming back; the cards themselves look the same.
